_comment: Curated tags (spec/04-ONTOLOGY.md 8). Plays that are interesting for
reasons no grammar can see. Loaded into play_tags with source='curated',
never produced by the deriver and never overwritten by a re-derive.
Every name here must already exist in the ontology: this file records
human judgement about which plays qualify, not about what the vocabulary
is. An unknown name is a load error, so a typo cannot invent a tag that
Each entry carries a citation, because a curated tag is an assertion
someone has to be able to check.
